description.value: Onigiri Ya is a Japanese rice ball shop on Robson Street in Vancouver's downtown core, one of three Vancouver locations operated by the Maruhachi Ramen Group. The shop focuses on freshly made onigiri available for pre-order pickup, offering a quick and portable meal well-suited to cyclists on the move. The Robson branch is steps from the seawall and major cycling routes through the city centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Onigiri Ya Robson is an active pickup/pre-order Japanese rice ball shop at 202-345 Robson Street, operated by Maruhachi Ramen Group, matching OSM operator and branch tags. The website lists the postal code as V6B 0H3 while OSM records V6B 6B3 — a discrepancy flagged below; the website value is used as current. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; takeout is clearly confirmed as the primary service model.
